## Profile

I am a Full Instructor of Social Science/Academic Specialist at New York University Abu Dhabi. I work in international relations and comparative politics, with research on European strategic culture, digital sovereignty, technology regulation, and international security.

I earned a PhD in Political Science from the University of California, Irvine in 2022. I hold a Master of International Studies from North Carolina State University and a BA in Political Science and Psychology from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

## Teaching

At NYU Abu Dhabi, I teach international security, quantitative methods, GIS, negotiation, business analytics, and capstone seminars. I mentor capstone students on data management and analysis. In January 2026, I co-taught *Practicing Politics in the Age of Disruption* with the Rt. Hon. Lord Cameron, former UK prime minister.

At UC Irvine, I taught political science discussion sections and delivered guest lectures. At North Carolina State University, I taught international relations. View my [teaching profile](teaching/index.html), [courses](teaching/courses/index.html), and [guest lectures](teaching/guest-lectures.html).

## Research

I study European strategic culture, digital sovereignty, European technology regulation, Arctic security, and relations among Europe, China, Russia, and the United States. Read my doctoral dissertation, *[Emergent Strategic Culture: Post-Cold War Europe Navigating Great Power Relations with the U.S., Russia, and China](https://escholarship.org/uc/item/8j968169)*, on UC eScholarship.

Since 2023, I have presented research on the European technology stack, Arctic security, the Digital Markets Act and Digital Services Act, and European digital sovereignty. See my [research, publications, and conference presentations](research/index.html).

## Research methods and technical skills

I use R, Stata, Python, and QGIS for statistical analysis, text analysis, web scraping, network analysis, qualitative comparative analysis, and multi-method research design. At UC Irvine, I used R to collect and analyze text on EU-China relations and social media.

I speak advanced French and have studied Arabic and Russian.

## Selected experience and service

  * **Research Assistant, UC Irvine:** I collected primary and secondary sources for a global value chains project and analyzed social media text in R.

  * **Political Section Intern, U.S. Mission to the European Union:** I researched Roma integration, EU crisis-management planning, and the security implications of space debris.

  * **University service:** I interviewed prospective NYU Abu Dhabi students and served as faculty liaison for UC Irvine political science graduate students.

## Professional development

I completed the AI-Responsive Teaching Essentials certificate through NYU's Hilary Ballon Center for Teaching and Learning in September 2026. I have completed programs in course design, mentoring, R and Python programming, data analysis, network analysis, text mining, and qualitative and multi-method research. View my [certificates and professional training](teaching/training.html).
